current_bottleneck: Run002 completed corporate outage/crash/restart recovery and both actual settlement rounds, but the cycle finalizer chose a terminal file from a contract filename suffix. For the worker contract it prematurely ended the five-validator observer before cancellation/expiry. The subsequent DNS error was downstream of that observed early exit.
causal_hypothesis: Reusing the existing encrypted outbox and exact native journal stages, with a process-lifetime OS lock and authenticated health-only node RPCs, lets a resident dispatcher recover the same reserve and same seven ciphertexts without double application.
single_intended_change: Complete the same native worker journey by routing lifecycle continuation and worker verification from the verified contract ID, not filenames. Before first publication of this component also domain-separate dispatch encryption from journal encryption and report retry-exhausted manual-review entries instead of idle, with two deterministic regression tests. No DNS retries, financial re-signing, matching or settlement authority changes.
